name: HiPhO
intro: HiPhO 使用 2024-2025 年 7 项物理奥赛的 13 套官方试卷评估 (M)LLM。论文基准包含 360 道题、519 个小题，覆盖 5 个物理领域、4 种模态和 6 种答案类型；每个题解对均经专家人工核验，7 套考试提供官方步骤评分细则，最终按考试总分映射官方金银铜牌线。

build_method: 官方试卷OCR, 题解索引匹配, 全量专家核验, 评分细则结构化, 多维标注
metric: 考试总分, 答案级与步骤级得分, 金银铜牌等级
task_type: 开放式问答, 选择题
eval_feature: 官方评分细则, 部分分, 多解取最高分, 多模态, 人机奖牌对比
scale: 13套试卷, 360道题, 519个小题；7套含评分细则
build_method_en: Official-exam OCR, question-answer index matching, complete expert verification, marking-scheme structuring, multidimensional annotation
eval_feature_en: Official marking schemes, partial credit, best-of-multiple solutions, multimodal input, human medal comparison
intro_en: HiPhO evaluates (M)LLMs on 13 official papers from seven 2024-2025 physics Olympiads. The paper benchmark contains 360 problems and 519 subquestions across five physics fields, four modality types, and six answer types. Experts manually verify every QA pair; seven exams include official step-level marking schemes, and total exam scores map to official gold, silver, and bronze thresholds.
scale_en: 13 exam papers, 360 problems, 519 subquestions; 7 papers include marking schemes
metric_en: Exam score, answer- and step-level score, Gold/Silver/Bronze level

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2509.07894, especially Sections 3.1-3.3 and Appendices A.1-A.2, plus the official SciYu/HiPhO release. The paper snapshot selects 13 exam papers from seven influential 2024-2025 physics Olympiads based on influence and availability of human scores. Official PDFs are converted to markdown by OCR while preserving LaTeX, questions and answers are matched by indices, and experts manually verify every QA pair, correcting OCR errors, mismatches, and answer inconsistencies. Seven exams provide official marking schemes; criteria are converted into model-readable step rubrics, and four exams support multiple official solutions. Post-processing completes context, structures interdependent subquestions, and specifies required units. The final paper benchmark has 360 problems, 519 subquestions, 308 English and 52 Chinese problems, five physics fields, four modality types, six answer types, and three difficulty levels. Answer grading uses a rule-based math verifier followed by a strong-model review for failed equivalent matches. For exams with marking schemes, a strong model awards step-level partial credit and takes the highest score across valid official solution paths; exams without schemes use answer-level grading. Problem scores sum to exam scores and map to official medal thresholds.
